dry.banner: Dry run: scripted answers (not the published video)

notes: The README video (decision 0043). Two passes: capture.py runs the script on qwen2.5:3b (no browser), then the take replays those answers through the real app (replay_server.py) while the browser records.
`script` is the order of state changes and questions; capture.py and record.spec.ts follow it, so pass 2 meets the same library and the same prompts (matched by SHA-256).

Events: request, session, sources, token, done, error (the chat's SSE); answer (the turn's streamed text and the answer as stored); api events (the app's own JSON answers: intake, inspect, compare, rollback). A row with `on.event` is shown at the first matching event of its turn; `on.step` rows are shown by the take.
Payloads come only from the take's capture. Callouts are [file, symbol], resolved by lines.mjs at take time.

rows.subtitle: Ask questions about your own documents, fully offline. It cites its source, or says it isn't there.
Adding three new files. Nothing is indexed before you confirm.
Each file is embedded with bge-m3: its tags and shelf come from the closest documents.
On confirm, each file is stored once by its SHA-256, cut into pieces and indexed twice.
A question, on the hr shelf.
Two indexes, one ranking: bge-m3 vectors for meaning, SQLite FTS5 for exact words, fused by rank.
The top five passages go into a prompt that allows answers only from them, with citations.
qwen2.5:3b writes the answer from those passages, on this laptop's CPU.
Every citation is checked against the passages, and moved if the model cited the wrong one.
Click a citation: the exact passage, with its file, page and score.
Now a question the documents don't answer.
None of them holds the answer, so the reply is the one the prompt requires. No guessing.
Versions. First, the return window in the current policy.
30 days, from version 1 of the shipping and returns policy.
Now the policy changes: the new file has the same name.
Same name, new content: the app makes it version 2 of the document.
v2 is indexed and active; v1's pieces stay in the index, inactive. Ask again.
Now 45 days, from version 2.
Roll back to v1: one pointer flips. Nothing is embedded again.
The retrieval inspector shows every passage, its ranks, where the cut falls, and the exact prompt.
Move the vector weight and the ranking changes live; the question's embedding is reused.
A golden set of 53 questions scores every change: here vectors only against hybrid search.
Hybrid finds the right file in the top five for every question.
Local RAG with Ollama: every answer cites its source, or says it isn't there.
